raw_wikitext:
'''Prunelle Rulens''' is a Belgian actress who voiced [[Sophie Casterwill]] in the French dub of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]''. 

She is also the voice of [[w:c:totaldrama:Courtney|Courtney]] in the French dub of the animated series ''[[w:c:totaldrama:Total Drama Island (2007)|Total Drama Island]].''
